Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (zcode:enrich-mytheme-l3), per scene:
#1 ruler — THE 3D SCENE. z is the veil's two sides: the blind ruler inside his field (z −0.3), the field's edge around him (z −0.1), the voice from incorruptibility answering from beyond (z +0.45) — absence from the field contradicted by a presence above it, literally in depth. The ruler's sequence stages the declaration: blind disc → the claim 'sole god' appearing gold → the disc dimmed by the rebuke. Vortex + shove pointer (the contradiction). Depth occlusion with veil-dark tint. Duration 13.
#2 adam — pursuit staged: repel + shove pointer, turbulence 0.15; the woman's sequence walks her escape ☾ → Tree → ☾ (she eludes pursuit by becoming what they would pluck, then returns beyond them); Adam's sequence brightens from earthen decoy to living. The shadow disc stays dim and present — the violated figure is not made to disappear. Duration 12.
#3 norea — the hardest shove in the journey (0.55): coercion attempted and refused; auto-cry, a sine LFO on pointerStrength — the cry rising; the claim sequence walks ☸☸ → 'from the world above' → ☸☸ dimmed: her origin-answer diminishing their claim. Duration 11 — the refusal is the sharpest beat.
#4 eleleth — grid layout: the retrospective cosmology laid out in its layers; attract pointer (the luminary's descent — rescue draws near); the genesis chain walked veil → shadow → matter → lion-faced ruler (the record's own sequence beneath the veil, pale to dark, then the deficient gold); Zoe's rebuke walks Z → fire → Z (the breath become the fiery angel). Duration 14 — the teaching takes time.
#5→0 return — the promise sequence 3 → 'disclosure to come' → 3: the ending kept prospective, as the record keeps it; attract at 0.25, the gentlest hold — the promised liberation is not forced. Duration 15, the longest beat.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: the journey opens inside the ruler's claim — a blind disc mistaking its field for reality, answered from above by one voice — and closes along the same vertical with the root-above arrow standing: the voice that contradicted Samael has become, by the end, Norea's ground and the hymn's collective address. The claim 'sole god' that opened in gold ends dimmed in #1's own sequence; the coercion that drove #2–#3 is answered not by a stronger ruler but by provenance disclosed — false sovereignty corrected, not overthrown. The ☮ that rebuked at #1, carried Norea's cry at #3, and returns in the closing hymn's collective voice at #5→0: the beyond is not empty, and the ending is still to come.
Human-amplified staging: the four system candidates stay human-amplified: no, verbatim in the #5→0 body; the Veil/Māyā and archon/evaluator comparisons remain proposals with their different metaphysical valences stated. Mythemic verbs only: the story discloses authority through the acts staged; no dictionary key, no ancient derivation of QL.
Automation: auto-cry (#3, field.params.pointerStrength sine — the cry rising), tied to the record's move. Durations 11–15 and transitions 1.2–2.2: the refusal sharpest, the teaching and the promise held longest.

glyph_rationales.the blind chief ruler — crowned, sightle: the chief ruler drawn crowned with empty eyes and pronouncing mouth — the arrogance that sees only its own field (the rebuke names him Samael).
glyph_rationales.Samael — the dense centre of the claim: the blind god's dense centre — the name the voice from incorruptibility gives him in correcting his claim.
glyph_rationales.his field's edge — no visible superior i: the ring of his horizon — inside it no superior appears, and he reads that absence as absence from reality.
glyph_rationales.the voice from incorruptibility — the ra: the ray striking in from outside the ring — 'you are mistaken, Samael': the contradication from the realm his field cannot contain.
glyph_rationales.the image they perceived — a reflection: the ring above the formed man — the reflected beauty the rulers chase and try to possess through their formation.
glyph_rationales.Adam — formed of earth after the perceiv: the human figure drawn of earth — formed by the rulers, yet unraised until a power they do not own descends.
glyph_rationales.spirit descending from the Adamantine La: the falling spark — the breath from above that the makers could not supply.
glyph_rationales.the spiritual woman — awakening Adam, es: her two drawn states — waking Adam, then the tree she becomes to slip the rulers' pursuit.
glyph_rationales.the shadow — violated; materially necess: the dark blot left in the narrative — the violated figure the telling retains so Norea's denial of their genealogy has its ground.
glyph_rationales.⛔: the garden's prohibition — sleep becoming ignorance, expulsion and imposed toil in the rulers' garden.
glyph_rationales.Norea — upright, refusing the imposed de: the figure drawn with arm extended in refusal — Eve's daughter denying the ancestry the rulers claim through her.
glyph_rationales.the rulers' claim — coercion attempted t: the reaching talons — authority asserted as grasp; the coercion her cry answers.
glyph_rationales.her cry to the higher divine reality: the ascending spark — the call that brings Eleleth down.
glyph_rationales.the ark refused, breathed aflame: the ark drawn intact, then alight — Noah's excluded vessel burned by Norea's breath; her relation to the flood refused.
glyph_rationales.the veil between the realms — shadow gat: the wide dashed band — the boundary above which the incorruptible lies and beneath which shadow becomes matter.
glyph_rationales.Eleleth — golden appearance, snowy cloth: the radiant figure — the luminary who rescues Norea and teaches the rulers' own genesis.
glyph_rationales.the lion-faced ruler — his eyes opening: the lion face in two states — eyes shut, then open on matter without visible prior: the second totalising claim.
glyph_rationales.7: the seven offspring and the layered heavens — Sabaoth in the seventh heaven beneath the veil.
glyph_rationales.Zoe's rebuke — the breath become a fiery: the drawn flame — Zoe's breath that binds Yaldabaoth in Tartaros and raises Sabaoth's throne.
glyph_rationales.the root above — Norea's origin, a tree: the tree drawn inverted — roots reaching up to the light of the world above the rulers' universe.
glyph_rationales.the image claimed — formation as decoy,: the drawn frame with its reflection — valuing an image by possessing what it discloses; the rulers' decoy and claim turned back on them.
glyph_rationales.3: the promised disclosure after three generations — the true Man who will bring it; the ending held open.
glyph_rationales.♪: the closing hymn — the collective voice before Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
